lead.headline: Zvada's 2 points are the hole — the rest is set
lead.deck: No starter carries a designation. Gay kicks this afternoon; anything above 2 makes Thursday's swap a loss.
lead.body: Dominic Zvada, added Thursday for Matt Gay, kicked two points against Washington; Gay plays at Las Vegas this afternoon. That is the bad news, and it is already banked. Everything else is in place: the lineup is the projection lineup and none of Taylor, Tuten, Golden, Rice or Gordon has a designation. Garrett Wilson cleared the concussion protocol this morning but stays on the bench, 0.6 behind Rice — a coin flip. Josh Jacobs had finger surgery and is expected back in a few weeks. Daniels and Likely have 49.96 banked against the unbeaten Maye-day; ESPN gives you 58%.
